comment: Shared truth table for the effective-rate-on-a-date rule. Read by backend/src/accounts/effective-loan-rate.util.spec.ts and by frontend/src/lib/loan-rate-timeline.contract.test.ts, because the two layers cannot import each other and the scheduled loan bill must price at the same rate the amortization report projects (INV-LOAN-006).

cases.name: no rows falls back to the account scalar
the latest row on or before the date wins
a row dated after the date is not yet in effect
a row dated exactly on the date is in effect
every row still in the future falls back to the scalar
a recorded 0% is a rate, not an absent one
unordered rows resolve the same as ordered ones
no rows and no scalar is unknown, not zero
